item.title: Narangi | Pakistani Bridal Wear | Rawayat
item.description: Discover Narangi, a Pakistani bridal wear piece from Rawayat. Description A regal heirloom aglow in the warm, luminous hues of a Mughal sunset. The pure lama tissue frock rises in a graceful sweetheart bodice - structured, sculpted, and fit for a queen - before cascading into a magnificently full silhouette that sweeps the floor in majestic grandeur. Every inch is lavished with old-school intricate floral handwork, a rich living tapestry of mukaish, resham thread, dabka, naqshi, and sequins that shimmer and dance like a golden garden illuminated by candlelight - each motif more breathtaking than the last, each stitch a testament to a vanishing art. Beneath unfurls a self-woven zari jamawar lehenga, its golden motifs woven into the very cloth like buried treasure unearthed from a royal atelier, its lustre deep, warm, and timeless. Completing the ensemble, a pure organza dupatta drapes in ethereal softness, light as a whisper against the opulent richness beneath. A vision of courtly magnificence - warm, luminous, and steeped in the splendour of a bygone era, for the bride who wears heritage like a crown of gold.
